name: Badanami Futures Fund
summary: Emergency and futures grants for Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander WSU students facing financial need or study barriers.
key: Emergency Grants up to $500; Futures Grants up to $2,000, with an overall maximum of $2,000 per application.
who: Identify as an Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander person
Currently enrolled at Western Sydney University
Demonstrate financial need or a barrier to study
how: Apply via the Apply Now form; Emergency Grants need only a personal statement and COI
catches: Up to two instances within an 18-month period

source.label: Western Sydney University: Badanami Futures Fund

evidence.quote: an overall maximum of $2,000 per application.
